messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: OOM on node gpu-23 (container:redwood-infer-42). Headroom reported ~480MB before spike. Auto-evict attempted and failed. Logs: `cudaErrorOutOfMemory` + reserve allocation failure. Link: https://internal.ops/alerts/2971209999

 evan (oncall): Acknowledged. I'm on it. Which customers/routes affected? nina, can you pull the runtime dump?

 nina (runtime): pulling logs now. Preliminary: allocator reports "reserved_blocks_locked=3" and multiple small free segments -> heavy fragmentation. Interesting bit: headroom metric still showing ~400-600MB available in node agent but allocator rejects new reserve allocations.

 ali (sre): Noted. That matches rare case where reserved slabs are non-contiguous and kernel-level allocation fails despite aggregate free mem. Could be stale KV cache pinning. evan, recommend immediate mitigation: attempt targeted KV cache eviction on affected container to free contiguous region.

 ryan (infra): node telemetry: gpu-23 had 14h uptime, fragmentation score = 0.82, recent topology change (OOM kill from another pod ~2h ago). Not seeing kernel OOM, only CUDA OOM from our process. Suggest disabling dynamic prefetch on that node while we triage.

 evan (oncall): nina, can you evict KV cache for container? What's the admin endpoint?

 nina (runtime): running admin evict now: ```curl -X POST "https://runtime-admin/redwood-infer-42/evict_kv_cache" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"range":"prefix:*","size_limit_mb":256}'``` Returning: "evicted=190MB, pinned_blocks=1".

 incident-bot: Action recorded: evict_kv_cache for redwood-infer-42 triggered by nina at 2971210200.

 nina (runtime): immediate log after evict: still seeing allocation failure for a 256MB reserve: ```allocator: reserve_alloc(256MB) -> error: reserved_block_split_failed``` Looks like reserved blocks are fragmented and split operation failing.

 ali (sre): Ok, escalate to infra-level: soft-restart the container runtime agent to force coalescing of free segments and release stale reservations. Risk: small window of request loss. Recommend draining from LB first. evan, authorize?

 evan (oncall): Authorize drain + soft-restart. Prioritize minimal customer impact: put node in maintenance, shift traffic to fallback pool. zoe, heads up to CS.

 zoe (cx): Got it. Which customers saw 5xx? I can DM them. I need a short incident blurb for now.

 ryan (infra): Performing cordon + drain: `kubectl cordon gpu-23 && kubectl drain gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` Starting soft-restart of runtime-agent on node.

 incident-bot: Deployment action: runtime-agent restart job started (job_id=ra-2971210800). Expected restart ~45s.

 nina (runtime): restart complete. Post-restart metrics: allocator shows free contiguous region ~1.2GB, reserve allocations succeeding. Running regen tests. No immediate OOMs in last 60s.

 evan (oncall): Good. Rolling health check: traffic shifted back to node in canary (10%). Monitoring.

 ali (sre): While this mitigated symptoms, root cause looks like a combination: high fragmentation after repeated small allocations + stale pinned reserves from prefetch path. We need a follow-up to harden allocator split logic and improve telemetry that surfaces "failed-split" events earlier.

 nina (runtime): Agreed. Also propose safe fallback: if reserve_split fails, attempt smaller-chunk reserve fallback path instead of immediate OOM. Adds ~5-10ms overhead but prevents service disruption.

 zoe (cx): Customers affected: 3 dedicated tenants on cluster-eu. Two reported increased latency/5xx for ~2-4min during the incident window. I'll send a proactive note: "We observed intermittent OOM-driven errors on cluster-eu causing short request failures; mitigation applied and traffic restored. We're investigating and will follow up."

 evan (oncall): Status update: mitigated -> partial restore. Node remains cordoned for extended validation (~30min). No active OOMs. Handoff: I'm handing to ali for next shift; ali will coordinate RCA writeup and rollout for hotfix. ETA for RCA draft: 24h.

 ali (sre): Taking handoff. Immediate follow-ups: 1) create incident ticket INC-2971209999, 2) gather allocator traces and reserved-block bitmap for gpu-23, 3) plan safe allocator fallback patch, 4) add alert rule for reserve_split_failures.

 nina (runtime): I'll upload detailed logs and a heapmap: https://internal.logs/2971209999/heapmap (internal only). Also adding test that simulates fragmentation pattern using small repeated prefetches.

 ryan (infra): Node reboot not required. Will uncordon after validation window unless we see regressions.

 zoe (cx): Drafted customer note and flagged two customers for high-touch outreach. Will coordinate with sales for account context.

 evan (oncall): Closing live mitigation. If anything spikes, ping #incidents immediately. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

 ali (sre): Postmortem items will include timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigating short-term config (disable prefetch on long-lived nodes), long-term patch plan, and regression tests. Assign owners in ticket.

 nina (runtime): leaving a runbook addition: "When allocator reports reserve_split_failed but headroom > X, try: evict_kv_cache -> restart runtime-agent -> if persists, cordon node and run debug tool collect_reserve_map.sh" I'll upload tonight.
